## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Vatican City, Vatican. It starts at Piazza Navona.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> The Church of Sant'Agnese in Agone is dedicated to a Roman martyr who died in 304 during Diocletian's final persecutions. This church stands as a testament to faith and sacrifice. The saint is known for her strong will and devotion to God, even unto death.
>
> Whether you're a curious tourist or a pilgrim, a visit to the Church offers a chance to explore and learn about its history and spirituality.
